description:
Two Explorers, one Tomorrow.
We Were Here Tomorrow is coming to PlayStation 5.

In this next standalone entry of the We Were Here series, you and your partner wake up inside a mysterious facility. Strange machinery surrounds you, and a calm, confident voice guides you through a series of assignments.

Often separated and equipped with different tools, you’ll need to rely on your walkie-talkies to communicate clearly and work together. Each assignment introduces new asymmetrical puzzles that can only be solved through cooperation, trust, and shared information.

Astraeos expands in a massive way with the arrival of Pyranthos. This update pushes the map forward with fresh explorable areas, an amphibious living fortress, and a multi-headed nightmare.

The Pyranthos Wasteland
Far from an empty desert, Pyranthos is a vast new landmass shaped by myth, ruin, and survival. It is a hostile, ancient region where shifting sands give way to forgotten structures and buried pathways, and environments designed to test preparation as much as curiosity. Powerful creatures roam the surface and the depths below, while unexplored artifact caves and long-abandoned arenas beckon the curious. This environment is built for exploration, but it absolutely does not reward carelessness.

description:
It's time to take direct control with action-packed combat in this brand new take on the Disgaea franchise! 

The princess needs her pudding, but nothing's simple in the Netherworld! She'll need a hardy mercenary to mow down monsters and secure her dessert if she's to enjoy her culinary delights.

That's where you come in. As N.A., you'll need to level up, recruit demons, and pass bills at the Dark Chocolate Assembly to make sure you have what it takes to fight your own battles. That's right—for the first time ever, Disgaea has Magichanged into an action RPG! With up to seven weapon types, the equipment you bring into battle changes the way you play. Shoot, slash, or smash your way through hundreds of enemies when Disgaea Mayhem hits PlayStation 5, and Steam summer 2026.
